purpose: Single-trajectory failure diagnosis on a public interactive task; not a contest submission or method ranking claim

methods.notes: Upstream full observed history, default action prompt, no reflection or summarization
AgentOdyssey prompted state-compression adaptation, approximate 512-token memory, repaired JSON memory/action contract; not the original RL-trained MEM1 model
Same actual configuration as Remnant: mem0ai 2.2.1, FAISS semantic search, effective top_k=20; pre-execution memory update preserved and explicitly audited.

measurement: raw main quest and supplementary score
memory snapshots and full persistent memory
all API calls including memory overhead
actual API model identifiers and request/response archive
interpretation: One trajectory per method per game. Remaining games extend the same deployed policies without retuning on Remnant outcomes. Three-task observations are not a statistical ranking or proof of novelty.
preserved_known_limitations: Mem1 is a prompted adaptation, not the original trained MEM1 model.
Mem0 legacy limit parameters resolve to top-20, including partial per-step snapshots.
Mem0 task adapter writes observation and intended action before environment execution; retain for identical policy and classify resulting defects as integration failures.
